runs.name: score
runs.command: thinkthen score 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < outage.txt
runs.input: Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay.
runs.see: The outage scores 2.0, and 2 is Immediate on this scale.

runs.name: score-answer
runs.command: thinkthen score --details 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < outage.txt | jq '.answer.probabilities'
runs.input: Our checkout page is down and customers cannot pay.
runs.see: The details put all of the weight on Immediate.

runs.name: score-lines
runs.command: thinkthen score --lines 'How urgent is this?' 'Routine.' 'Soon.' 'Immediate.' < queue.txt | jq -r '"\(.value)  \(.input)"'
runs.input:
Please update my mailing address when you can.
Can you send the signed contract by Friday?
Nobody can log in to the site right now.
runs.output:
0.06  Please update my mailing address when you can.
0.99  Can you send the signed contract by Friday?
2.0  Nobody can log in to the site right now.
runs.see: The address change lands near 0, the Friday deadline near 1, and the login outage at 2.
